shortDescription: Company Recently Reported Quarterly Revenue More Than 50% Above Analyst Estimates as Omni One Expands into New High-Growth MarketsAUSTIN, Texas, Sept. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Virtuix Holdings Inc. NASDAQ:VTIX, a leading developer of AI-driven, full-body simulation systems, today announced that…

children: Company Recently Reported Quarterly Revenue More Than 50% Above Analyst Estimates as Omni One Expands into New High-Growth Markets

, a leading developer of AI-driven, full-body simulation systems, today announced that Virtuix’s Founder, Chief Executive Officer, and Chairman, Jan Goetgeluk, will highlight the Company’s recent financial and commercial momentum at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, being held September 14–16 at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel. Management’s meetings with institutional investors will follow a period of accelerating consumer demand and expanding commercial applications for Virtuix’s Omni One platform across defense, robotics, healthcare and enterprise markets.

Mr. Goetgeluk’s discussions will highlight recent developments including the Company’s expansion of Omni One within the Meta Quest ecosystem, humanoid robotics applications with Tesla, Counter-UAS training for the U.S. Marine Corps, and the growing use of Virtuix’s technology in healthcare applications, including autism therapy for children.

The H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference provides an opportunity for Virtuix to engage directly with institutional investors, family offices, and other members of the investment community.

“We entered this quarter with growing business momentum, following quarterly revenue that exceeded analyst expectations by more than 50%,” said Jan Goetgeluk. “Consumer demand for Omni One continues to grow, while the same underlying technology is gaining traction across defense, robotics, healthcare and enterprise applications. We look forward to presenting that broader Virtuix story directly to institutional investors at the H.C. Wainwright conference.”
H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference
Lotte New York Palace Hotel, New York, NY
Jan Goetgeluk, Founder, Chief Executive Officer, and Chairman

is a leading manufacturer of AI-driven, full-body simulation systems for consumer, enterprise, and defense markets.
